title: High Frequency Insomnia Extravaganza
author: WhiskeyBora
desc: Unlock your muscle-building potential with the High Frequency Insomnia Extravaganza, a dynamic 6-week program designed for both novice and intermediate lifters. With six sessions each week, you'll engage in focused workouts lasting just 50 minutes, maximizing efficiency and results. This full gym program emphasizes high-frequency training to stimulate muscle growth and enhance overall strength. Get ready to transform your physique and elevate your fitness journey!
